job.name: ig12_host_b
job.meaning: девушка ~30, тёмное каре до плеч с чёлкой, чёрная водолазка, красная помада, тёмная студия подкаста с растениями, микрофон на штанге, стол
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a charismatic Russian woman about 30, glossy dark-brown shoulder-length bob with soft bangs, a fitted black turtleneck, subtle red lipstick, thin gold necklace. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, waist-up, both shoulders inside the frame, centred, sitting at a dark wooden table with forearms resting on it, a black professional podcast microphone on a boom arm entering from the right side in front of her chest (not covering the face), top of head about 14% below the upper edge, face large and sharp, looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, playful confident half-smile, NO broad smile. Background: a dark moody podcast studio — black drapes, lush green plants, soft warm rim light, deep bokeh. Look: a real frame from a high-end podcast camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary woman (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
